# Sentence Improvement
> Total Questions: 1994

[Q1] I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual decision in unprejudiced way.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Morning)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) I have known her for many years. This time, she took an
(b) I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)
(c) I have known her for many years. This time, she took a
(d) I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual
[ANS] b
[SOL]
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an unusual decision in an unprejudiced way. Article 'an' is used before words starting with a vowel sound (an apple, an umbrella, an American). Similarly, in the given sentence, the words 'unusual' and 'unprejudiced' start with a vowel sound. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q2] My mom made her muffins, but she didn't eat none.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Afternoon)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) she did eat none
(b) she did ate many
(c) she didn't eat any
(d) she didn't ate any
[ANS] c
[SOL]
she didn't eat any 'None' is not used in a negative sentence. 'None' must be replaced with 'any' as we use 'any' in a negative sentence. Hence, "she didn't eat any" is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'she didn't eat any' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q3] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when
(b) A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when
(c) Tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea
(d) The tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when
[ANS] b
[SOL]
A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as the tide goes out. Indefinite article 'a/an' is used when we talk about a noun in general. Similarly, the given sentence talks about 'tide pool' and 'isolated pocket' in a general sense. We will use article 'a' before 'tide' (consonant sound) and article 'an' before 'isolated'(vowel sound). Article 'the' will be used before the 2 nd 'tide'. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q4] He behaves if he were a king.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) will be behaving as
(b) could be behaving as
(c) behaves as if
(d) has been behaving as
[ANS] c
[SOL]
behaves as if 'As if' is used to talk about a situation that may not be true but that is possible. Similarly, in the given sentence, the person may not be a king but he behaves like a king. Hence, 'behaves as if' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'behaves as if' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q5] What do you like to do on your free days other than to watching movies?
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 11/12/2024 (Morning)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) watch movie
(b) watching movies
(c) watches movies
(d) having watched movies
[ANS] b
[SOL]
watching movies We use a noun, pronoun or a gerund(V ing ) after the phrase 'other than'. Therefore, 'to' will be removed. Hence, 'watching(V ing ) movies' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'watching movies' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q6] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 11/12/2024 (Afternoon)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He would be meets us next week.
(b) He would not be met us next week.
(c) He will be meet us next week.
(d) He will be meeting us next week.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
He will be meeting us next week. The given sentence is in the future continuous tense and follows the structure, "Third person pronoun + will + be + V ing ". Hence, the sentence given in option(d) is correct.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'He will be meeting us next week.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q7] While I was waiting for Asha for shopping, I spilled lemonade on my new trousers
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 11/12/2024 (Afternoon)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) to hold shop
(b) to shop
(c) to shopper
(d) to see shopping
[ANS] b
[SOL]
to shop Infinitive(to + V 1 ) is used after the verb 'wait'. Therefore, 'for shopping' must be replaced with 'to shop(V 1 )'. Hence, 'to shop' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'to shop' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q8] Whether she wishes to relocate to Mumbai or continues to live here are her personal decisions.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 11/12/2024 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) is her personal decision
(b) were her personal decisions
(c) No substitution required
(d) have her personal decision
[ANS] a
[SOL]
is her personal decision 'Whether '… or' is a pair of conjunctions. According to the "Rule of Proximity", the verb is supplied according to the subject closest to the verb. In the given sentence, the close subject is a verb phrase 'continues to live', which denotes a single action. Therefore, singular verb 'is' will be used. Hence, 'is her personal decision' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'is her personal decision' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q17] Monika said to her mother that, 'I have passed the examination.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 08/10/2024 (Morning)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Monika said to her mother that, "I am passed
(b) Monika said to her mother, "I have passed
(c) No improvement required
(d) Monika said to her mother that, "she has passed
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed If the reported speech is given in inverted commas(" " ), it is called direct speech. However, in the direct speech, we do not use any conjunctions ('that', 'if', 'whether') after the reporting verb (say). Therefore, 'that' will be removed from the given sentence. Hence, option(b) is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Monika said to her mother, "I have passed' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

(c) That Macbook belongs to Xavier.
(d) That Macbook is belonged to Xavier.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
That Macbook belongs to Xavier. According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. At the end of a singular verb, s/es is used. In the given sentence, 'That Macbook' is a singular subject that will take 'belongs' as a singular verb. Hence, the sentence given in option(c) is correct.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'That Macbook belongs to Xavier.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

(d) the most
[ANS] b
[SOL]
more If two or more adjectives are joined with a conjunction, these adjectives are written in the same degree. In the given sentence, 'and' joins two adjectives, out of which one is comparative degree(taller). Therefore, the second adjective will also be written in comparative degree. 'More handsome' is the correct comparative degree of 'handsome'. Hence, 'more' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CPO 2023 Tier - 1
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'more' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[SOL]
were seen According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. [Q529] Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'. None the less, (many an old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, has) kept their romances to the end.

[Q578] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CPO 10/11/2022 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]

(d) Amateur is a person who takes part in a activity for pleasure.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
We generally use the indefinite article 'a' before the words starting with a consonant sound and article 'an' before words starting with a vowel sound. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'noun', 'person', 'hobby', 'job' are some words that are starting with a consonant sound & 'activity' is the only word that starts with a vowel sound. Hence, 'Amateur' is a noun which refers to a person who takes part in an activity as a hobby or for pleasure and not as a job' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'An amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'by far the best' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

(b) haven't you?
(c) have you?
(d) No substitution required
[ANS] b
[SOL]
According to the " Question Tag rule ", if the statement is positive, the question tag will be negative but in the contracted form('t) & Vice-versa. The phrase 'In order to' means "so that" and the phrase 'Owing to' means 'because of'. For example, The match was cancelled owing to(because) bad weather. Similarly in the given question, the train was delayed because of an accident. Hence, ' owing to ' will be the most appropriate answer. (d)
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'owing to' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q788] The large mansion was over his reaching.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 24/11/2020 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) above his reaching
(b) away from reaching
(c) beyond his reach
(d) No substitution required
[ANS] c
[SOL]
beyond his reach. The phrase 'Beyond someone's reach' is used to show that something is not close enough to be touched or picked up by someone and not within someone's power to do or achieve. Similarly, for the given question, 'the mansion was beyond his reach' will be the most appropriate answer because it means that it is not possible for him to buy that expensive mansion. (c)
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'beyond his reach' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q789] Suman performed at the festival well yesterday.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 25/11/2020 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) at the festival yesterday well
(b) No substitution required
(c) well at the festival yesterday
(d) yesterday at the festival well
[ANS] c
[SOL]
well at the festival yesterday According to the " MPT rule ", the standard word order for adverbs from starting to end is as follows: Adverb of Manner (How), Adverb of Place( Where), Adverb of Time (When). Similarly in this given sentence, She performed well(Manner) at the festival(Place) yesterday(Time) will be the most appropriate answer. (c)
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'well at the festival yesterday' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q790] The exam was not so easy that we had expected.

(a) as easy as
(b) as easy so
(c) such easy as
(d) No substitution required
[ANS] a
[SOL]
as easy as. 'Sothat' is a conjunction which is used to show the purpose, but when we compare things, we use the structure 'asas'. Hence, 'the exam was not as easy as we had expected' is the most appropriate answer. (a)

[Q799] Despite of his best efforts, he failed to secure the top rank.

(d) which it has been approved,
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: When a clause is nonrestrictive, it needs a comma before it. The word 'though' introduces a subordinate clause, so the comma is required.
उदा. "हालाँकि यह प्रस्ताव स्वीकृत हो चुका है, यह अगले तिमाही में लागू किया जाएगा।"

(d) improvement the functioning

[SOL]
Rule: After a modal verb like 'will', use the base form of the verb.
उदाहरण: "नई नीति विभाग के कार्य को बेहतर बनाएगी।"
[RULE] Modal + base verb

[SOL]

[Q842] If I was you, I would not tolerate this kind of insult.

(a) If I am you
(b) If I were you
(c) If I has been you
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an unreal subjunctive desire or situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, regardless of number.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी subjects के साथ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

[Q843] She is junior than most of her colleagues in the administrative department.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]

(a) junior to most of
(b) junior from most of
(c) more junior than most of
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Latin comparative adjectives ending in '-or' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, prior, etc.) are followed by the preposition 'to', not 'than'.
उदा. 'junior', 'senior' आदि शब्दों के बाद तुलना करने के लिए 'than' नहीं बल्कि 'to' प्रीपोजिशन का प्रयोग होता है।

[Q844] Neither the manager nor his assistants was present at the conference meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were present
(b) are present
(c) have present
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, the closer subject 'assistants' is plural, so 'were' should be used.
उदा. जब दो विषय 'neither... nor' से जुड़ते हैं, तो क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'assistants' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

[Q845] No sooner did the sun rise when the fog disappeared completely.

(a) than the fog disappeared
(b) then the fog disappeared
(c) as the fog disappeared
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction used with 'No sooner' is 'than'. Therefore, 'than the fog disappeared' is correct.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है।

[Q846] One of the most challenging problems faced by the researchers are funding.

(a) is funding
(b) were funding
(c) have been funding
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' takes a plural noun followed by a singular verb because the subject of the sentence is 'One'. Thus, 'is funding' is correct.
उदा. संरचना 'One of + plural noun' के बाद verb हमेशा singular (एकवचन) आती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'One' होता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

[Q847] The principal as well as the teachers were accused of negligence of duty.

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) was accused
(b) are accused
(c) have been accused
(d) No improvement

[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', 'with', 'along with', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The principal', which is singular). Hence, 'was accused' is correct.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार प्रयोग होती है। 'The principal' एकवचन है, अतः 'was' आएगा।

[Q848] Despite of working hard, he could not clear the competitive examination.

(a) Despite working hard

'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' takes 'of'. Therefore, 'Despite working hard' is the correct usage.

[Q849] He told me that he is writing a novel for the past three years.

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) he has been writing
(b) he was writing
(c) he had written
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The sentence contains a time expression indicating duration ('for the past three years') along with past narration. Therefore, the past perfect continuous tense ('has been writing' or changed to past 'had been writing') is required. Since options provide 'he has been writing', it fits best.

[Q850] She is looking forward to meet her old friends at the annual reunion.

(a) looking forward to meeting
(b) looking forward to met
(c) look forward to meet
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrasal verb 'look forward to' is always followed by a gerund (verb + -ing), not a bare infinitive.
उदा. वाक्यांश 'look forward to' के बाद हमेशा gerund (v1 + ing) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

[Q851] Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class yesterday.

(a) were present
(b) are present
(c) have present
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'students' (plural), so the plural verb 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

[Q852] She is more smarter than her sister in solving complex puzzles.

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) much smarter
(b) smarter
(c) more smart
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Double comparatives are grammatically incorrect in English. 'Smarter' is already a comparative adjective, so using 'more' before it is redundant.

(a) If I were the king
(b) If I am the king
(c) If I has been the king
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary or unreal past/present situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones ('I', 'he', 'she').
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive Mood) में सभी Subjects के साथ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences (Subjunctive Mood)

[Q854] The manager as well as his subordinates were arrested for corruption.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) was arrested
(b) are arrested
(c) have arrested
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', 'with', 'along with', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, the first subject 'The manager' is singular, so the singular verb 'was' is required.
उदा. जब दो Subjects 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb पहले Subject के अनुसार तय होती है। यहाँ 'The manager' singular है, इसलिए 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q855] No sooner did the train arrive at the station than the passengers rushed towards it.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) No sooner the train arrived
(b) No sooner had the train arrive
(c) No sooner did the train arrived
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is followed by inversion ('did the train arrive') and connected with 'than'. No change is required.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह से सही है। 'No sooner' के बाद Helping Verb ('did') और फिर Subject आता है, तथा आगे 'than' का प्रयोग होता है।

[Q856] He is one of those persons who is always ready to help others.

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) who are always ready
(b) who is ever ready
(c) whom are always ready
(d) No improvement

[SOL]
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the plural noun ('persons'), hence 'are' should be used instead of 'is'.
उदा. 'one of those + plural noun + who' की संरचना में Relative pronoun (who) के बाद आने वाली Verb हमेशा plural noun के अनुसार plural होती है।

[Q857] Despite of working hard, he could not clear the competitive exam.

(a) Despite working hard

'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. However, 'In spite' is always followed by 'of'. Therefore, 'Despite working' or 'In spite of working' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः 'Despite working' सही विकल्प है।

[Q858] The committee are unanimous in their decision regarding the new policy.

[SOL]
When a collective noun like 'committee' expresses unity or is unanimous, it takes a plural verb and plural pronoun ('their'). The sentence is correct.

[Q859] Each boy and each girl were given a prize by the principal.

(a) was given a prize

When two or more singular nouns are preceded by 'each' and connected by 'and', the verb must be singular. Thus, 'was given' should replace 'were given'.
उदा. जब दो Singular Nouns 'each' से जुड़े हों और 'and' से मिलें, तो Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

(a) was present

(d) No improvement

When subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager' which is singular, so 'was').

[Q861] Hardly had I stepped out of the house **when it started raining**.

(a) than it started raining

[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'.

[Q862] Neither of the two sisters **have cleared** the entrance exam.

(a) has cleared

[ANS] a

(a) from

[ANS] b
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' like junior, senior, superior, inferior take the preposition 'to', not 'than'.
उदा. junior, senior, superior आदि शब्दों के बाद तुलना के लिए 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं।

[Q864] If I **was you**, I would not accept this project.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were you
(b) am you
(c) had been you
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In hypothetical (imaginary) sentences starting with 'If', 'were' is used for all subjects, even singular ones.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood (Conditional Sentences)

---

[Q865] He speaks English **so fluently that** every one listens to him carefully.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) too fluently that
(b) very fluently so
(c) as fluently that
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'so... that' structure is appropriately used to show cause and effect.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह सही है। 'so... that' का प्रयोग कारण और परिणाम को दर्शाने के लिए बिल्कुल उचित है।
[RULE] Use of 'so... that' structure

---

[Q866] One of my friends **are visiting** the National Museum today.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) is visiting
(b) am visiting
(c) were visiting
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद नाउन बहुवचन (plural) होता है लेकिन वर्ब एकवचन (singular) होती है, इसलिए 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'One of'

---

[Q867] No sooner did the train arrive at the platform **than the passengers rushed** into it.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) when the passengers rushed
(b) then the passengers rushed
(c) than the passengers rushed
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', and the sentence correctly uses past indefinite tense in both clauses.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है और टेंस भी सही है। इसलिए इसमें किसी सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
[RULE] Inversion and Conjunctions ('No sooner... than')

---

[Q868] She told me that she **has finished** her home work an hour ago.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) had finished
(b) finished
(c) was finished
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When the main clause is in the past tense ('told'), the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense ('had finished').
उदा. मुख्य वाक्य पास्ट टेंस ('told') में है, इसलिए आगे का उपवाक्य भी पास्ट टेंस में ('had finished') होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Sequence of Tenses (Indirect Speech)

---

[Q869] Despite of working hard, **he could not pass** the examination.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite working hard
(b) In spite working hard
(c) Despite of work hard
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' does not take 'of' after it, whereas 'In spite' takes 'of'. Hence, 'Despite working' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (जबकी 'In spite of' होता है)। इसलिए 'Despite working' सही विकल्प है।
[RULE] Prepositions (Despite vs In spite of)

---

[Q870] The manager as well as his subordinates [were present] at the annual meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were present
(b) was present
(c) are present
(d) have present
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('manager', which is singular).
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो verb हमेशा पहले subject के अनुसार singular या plural होती है। यहाँ 'manager' singular है, इसलिए 'was present' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'as well as'

---

[Q871] Hardly had I stepped out of the house [than it started] raining heavily.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) than it started
(b) when it started
(c) then it started
(d) that it started
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when', not 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का (जो 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

---

[Q872] Neither of the two candidates [have submitted] their documents on time.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) have submitted
(b) has submitted
(c) are submitted
(d) were submitted
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun but takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of', 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular आती है। इसलिए 'has submitted' सही होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Neither of + Singular Verb)

---

[Q873] She told me that she [has finished] her project the previous day.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) has finished
(b) had finished
(c) finished
(d) was finished
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In indirect speech, past tense in the reporting verb ('told') changes the reported clause to past perfect if it denotes an action completed before a point in the past ('the previous day').
उदा. यदि reporting verb past tense में हो और sentence में 'the previous day' दिया हो, तो past indefinite tense बदलकर past perfect tense (had + V3) हो जाता है।
[RULE] Direct-Indirect Speech Tense Shift

---

[Q874] If I was the king, [I would abolish] all taxes for the poor.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) I would abolish
(b) I will abolish
(c) I can abolish
(d) I shall abolish
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an unreal/hypothetical past situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, followed by 'would + V1'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है और मुख्य clause में 'would + V1' आता है।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences (Type 2)

---

[Q875] He is [senior than me] in this department by five years.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) senior than me
(b) senior to me
(c) senior then me
(d) more senior than me
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Adjectives like 'senior', 'junior', 'superior', 'inferior' are followed by the preposition 'to', not 'than'.
उदा. 'Senior', 'junior', 'inferior', 'superior' जैसे Latin adjectives के बाद 'than' की जगह preposition 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Prepositions with Adjectives ending in '-or'

---

[Q876] Not only the principal [but also the teachers was] involved in organizing the fest.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) but also the teachers was
(b) but also the teachers were
(c) but the teachers was
(d) and the teachers were
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('teachers', which is plural).
उदा. जब subjects 'not only... but also' से जुड़ते हैं, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'teachers' plural है, इसलिए 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Not only... but also)

---

[Q877] The scenery of Kashmir [are charming] and mesmerizes every visit or
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) are charming
(b) were charming
(c) is charming
(d) have charming
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'Scenery', 'poetry', 'information', 'furniture' जैसे uncountable nouns हमेशा singular माने जाते हैं और इनके साथ singular verb ('is') का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Uncountable Nouns and Agreement

---

[Q878] Despite of working hard, [he could not clear] the civil services exam.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) he could not clear
(b) Despite working hard
(c) In spite of working hard
(d) Both B and C
[ANS] d
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' must be followed by 'of'. Both 'Despite working' and 'In spite of working' are grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी 'of' नहीं आता, जबकि 'In spite' के साथ हमेशा 'of' आता है। अतः विकल्प B और C दोनों सही हैं।
[RULE] Despite vs In spite of

---

[Q879] She asked me where [did I buy] such a beautiful dress.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) did I buy
(b) I bought
(c) had I bought
(d) I have bought
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In an indirect wh-question, the sentence structure changes to subject + verb (affirmative order), avoiding auxiliary inversion like 'did'.
उदा. Indirect question में wh-word के बाद पहले subject और फिर verb आती है (affirmative order), इसलिए 'did I buy' की जगह 'I bought' सही होगा।
[RULE] Indirect Interrogative Structure

[Q880] She has a very good idea ______ that will help the company reduce costs.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which
(b) that
(c) who
(d) whom
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The clause is a restrictive relative clause and requires the conjunction "that". 
उदा. सही वाक्य: She has a very good idea that will help the company reduce costs.
[RULE] Relative clause – restrictive clause

---

[Q881] The book, ______ was written by a famous author, was a bestseller.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which
(b) whom
(c) who
(d) whose
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The clause is non‑restrictive; it needs the relative pronoun "which". 
उदाहरण: The book, which was written by a famous author, was a bestseller.
[RULE] Non‑restrictive relative clause

---

[Q882] He will take the exam ______ the next week.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) during
(b) in
(c) at
(d) on
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The preposition "on" is used with days and dates. 
उदा. He will take the exam on the next week.
[RULE] Preposition with dates and days

---

[Q883] She had finished her work _____ if she had any doubts, she would have asked.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) that
(b) but
(c) although
(d) so
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The clause expresses contrast; "although" is appropriate. 
उदाहरण: She had finished her work although if she had any doubts, she would have asked.
[RULE] Conjunction for contrast

[Q884] Nobody knows the truth, ______ she is a key witness.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) even though
(b) although
(c) even if
(d) though
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrase introduces a fact that is unexpected; "even though" fits. 
उदाहरण: Nobody knows the truth, even though she is a key witness.
[RULE] Conjunction for unexpected fact

[Q885] The manager, ______ he was very strict, also had a good sense of humor.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which
(b) who
(c) whom
(d) whose
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The clause is non‑restrictive and refers to a person; "who" is used. 
उदाहरण: The manager, who was very strict, also had a good sense of humor.
[RULE] Non‑restrictive relative clause – person

[Q886] We should submit the report ______ the dead line is next Monday.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) by the
(b) on the
(c) before the
(d) at the
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correct preposition for a deadline is "before". 
उदाहरण: We should submit the report before the deadline is next Monday.
[RULE] Preposition for deadlines

---

[Q887] The city, ______ a bustling metropolis, is also known for its serene parks.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which
(b) that
(c) who
(d) whom
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The clause provides additional information; "which" is correct. 
उदाहरण: The city, which is a bustling metropolis, is also known for its serene parks.
[RULE] Non‑restrictive relative clause – place

[Q888] He could not attend the meeting, ______ he had an urgent assignment.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) because
(b) and
(c) however
(d) although
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The reason for not attending is given; "because" is appropriate. 
उदाहरण: He could not attend the meeting, because he had an urgent assignment.
[RULE] Conjunction for reason

---

[Q889] The proposal was rejected ______ it was not feasible.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) since
(b) when
(c) while
(d) although
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The cause is stated; "since" correctly indicates reason. 
उदाहरण: The proposal was rejected since it was not feasible.
[RULE] Conjunction for cause

[Q890] The committee, __in spite of the objections__ from the members, decided to proceed with the plan.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) despite the objections from the members
(b) despite objections from the members
(c) in spite of objections from the members
(d) in spite of the objections from the members
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace the phrase with a grammatically correct form using the preposition ‘despite’ without the article ‘the’ before ‘objections’.
उदा. The committee, despite objections from the members, decided to proceed.
[RULE] Use ‘despite’ instead of ‘in spite of’ when the following noun phrase requires no article.

[Q891] She succeeded __notwithstanding the difficulties__ encountered during the project.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) notwithstanding the difficulties encountered during the project
(b) notwithstanding the difficulties which were encountered during the project
(c) notwithstanding the difficulties encountered in the project
(d) Quaint
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Use ‘notwithstanding’ followed by a noun phrase. The clause ‘encountered during the project’ is a participial phrase and should not be separated by a comma.
उदा. She succeeded notwithstanding the difficulties encountered during the project.
[RULE] Replace the phrase with ‘notwithstanding’ + noun phrase (no comma).

---

[Q892] The new policy was implemented __on account of the increased demand__ for renewable energy.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) because of the increased demand for renewable energy
(b) on account of the increased demand for renewable energy
(c) due to the increased demand for renewable energy
(d) in view of the increased demand for renewable energy
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Both ‘on account of’ and ‘because of’ are acceptable. Here the correct replacement is ‘because of the increased demand for renewable energy’.
उदा. The new policy was implemented because of the increased demand for renewable energy.
[RULE] Replace ‘on account of’ with ‘because of’ for a more direct causal relation.

[Q893] He could not attend the meeting __as far as__ the weather conditions were concerned.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) as far as the weather conditions concerned
(b) as far as the weather conditions were concerned
(c) as far as the weather conditions
(d) as far as weather condition were concerned
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase ‘as far as… were concerned’ is the correct structure.
उदा. He could not attend the meeting as far as the weather conditions were concerned.
[RULE] Replace with ‘as far as … were concerned’ when referring to a specific aspect.

[Q894] The company will reduce expenses __in view of the economic down turn__.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) as a result of the economic downturn
(b) in view of the economic downturn
(c) in regard to the economic downturn
(d) on account of the economic downturn
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase ‘in view of’ is used to indicate reason or consideration.
उदा. The company will reduce expenses in view of the economic downturn.
[RULE] Use ‘in view of’ to mean ‘because of’ or ‘considering’.

[Q895] The event was postponed __as a result of the unforeseen circumstances__.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) because of the unforeseen circumstances
(b) by the unforeseen circumstances
(c) as a result of the unforeseen circumstances
(d) due to the unforeseen circumstances
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The phrase ‘as a result of’ is correctly used to show causation.
उदा. The event was postponed as a result of the unforeseen circumstances.
[RULE] Replace with ‘as a result of’ when explaining the cause.

[Q896] They will complete the task __in order to __ meet the dead line
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) in order to meet the deadline
(b) in order to the meeting the deadline
(c) in order for meeting the deadline
(d) Timid
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correct form is ‘in order to meet’ followed by the infinitive verb.
उदा. They will complete the task in order to meet the deadline.
[RULE] Use ‘in order to’ + infinitive to show purpose.

[Q897] The project was completed __by means of advanced technology__.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) by using advanced technology
(b) by means of advanced technology
(c) through means of advanced technology
(d) by the means of advanced technology
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The idiomatic phrase is ‘by means of’ and is used before a noun phrase.
उदा. The project was completed by means of advanced technology.
[RULE] Replace with ‘by means of’ to indicate the method.

[Q898] The final report will be submitted __in the event that__ the team needs more time.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) if the team needs more time
(b) in the case that the team needs more time
(c) in the event that the team needs more time
(d) when the team needs more time
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The expression ‘in the event that’ is used to express a conditional situation.
उदा. The final report will be submitted in the event that the team needs more time.
[RULE] Use ‘in the event that’ to denote a conditional situation.

---

[Q899] He will not attend the meeting __after all__ the committee members agreed.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) since the committee members agreed
(b) after all the committee members agreed
(c) once the committee members agreed
(d) after the committee members agreed
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase ‘after all’ is used to indicate that a conclusion follows after considering prior facts.
उदा. He will not attend the meeting after all the committee members agreed.
[RULE] Replace with ‘after all’ to signify final decision.

---

[Q900] The committee has decided to __ its meeting to next month.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) postpone
(b) postpone to
(c) postpone the
(d) postponed
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: After a verb that takes an infinitive complement, the infinitive should not have a preposition. Hence, "postpone" is correct.
उदाहरण: समिति ने अपनी बैठक अगले महीने को टालने का निर्णय लिया।
[RULE] Verb + Infinitive

---

[Q901] There is no doubt that the new policy will __ the economy.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) stimulate
(b) stimulate the
(c) stimulate the economy
(d) stimulates
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: When a verb is followed by a noun phrase, the verb should not be repeated. "Stimulate" suffices.
उदाहरण: नई नीति से अर्थव्यवस्था को प्रोत्साहन मिलेगा।
[RULE] Verb + Noun Phrase

---

[Q902] She insisted that he __ to the office by 9 a.m.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) arrive
(b) arrived
(c) arriving
(d) arrives
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: In a that-clause following a verb of insist, the verb is in the base form.
उदाहरण: उसने कहा कि वह 9 बजे तक कार्यालय पहुँचे।
[RULE] Verb + that-clause

---

[Q903] The new regulations aim to __ the standard of living across the country.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) improve
(b) improving
(c) improved
(d) improves
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: After a verb that takes a noun complement, use the base form of the verb.
उदाहरण: नई विनियमों का उद्देश्य देश में जीवन स्तर को बेहतर बनाना है।
[RULE] Verb + Noun Complement

---

[Q904] The scientist is known for his __ research in quantum physics.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) pioneering
(b) pioneered
(c) pioneeringly
(d) pioneer
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: The adjective form of a verb can be used to describe ongoing activity.
उदाहरण: वैज्ञानिक अपने अग्रणी अनुसंधान के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं।
[RULE] Adjective from Verb

---

[Q905] The manager urged the staff to __ their reports before the dead line
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) submit
(b) submitting
(c) submitted
(d) submits
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: After a verb such as urged, the base form of the following verb is required.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक ने कर्मचारियों से समय सीमा से पहले रिपोर्ट जमा करने का आग्रह किया।
[RULE] Verb + Base Form

---

[Q906] The proposal was rejected because it did not __ the required safety standards.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) meet
(b) meeting
(c) met
(d) meets
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: After a verb that takes a noun phrase complement, use the base form of the verb.
उदाहरण: प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार कर दिया गया क्योंकि वह आवश्यक सुरक्षा मानकों को पूरा नहीं करता।
[RULE] Verb + Noun Phrase

---

[Q907] He promised that he would __ the problem as soon as possible.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) solve
(b) solving
(c) solved
(d) solves
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: The verb following would in a conditional future clause is the base form.
उदाहरण: उसने वादा किया कि वह जल्द से जल्द समस्या हल करेगा।
[RULE] Conditional Future Clause

---

[Q908] The new policy will __ the chances of small businesses to thrive.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) increase
(b) increasing
(c) increased
(d) increases
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: After a verb that takes a noun complement, use the base form.
उदाहरण: नई नीति से छोटे व्यवसायों के समृद्ध होने के अवसर बढ़ेंगे।
[RULE] Verb + Noun Complement

---

[Q909] The report states that the company's profits have __ since last year.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XII (2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) increased
(b) increasing
(c) increase
(d) increases
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Past tense of a verb is used after a verb of stating in the past.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट बताती है कि कंपनी का लाभ पिछले वर्ष से बढ़ गया है।
[RULE] Past Tense after Reporting Verb

---

[Q910] She is knowing the truth about the incident since last week.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) has known the truth
(b) knows the truth
(c) knew the truth
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Verbs of perception or state (like know, understand, belong) are generally not used in continuous tenses. When used with 'since', they take the present perfect tense.
उदा. 'Know' जैसे Stative verbs का प्रयोग continuous tense में नहीं होता। 'Since' के साथ समय दिखाने के लिए Present Perfect Tense ('has known') का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Stative Verbs with Time Expressions

---

[Q911] Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were present
(b) are present
(c) have present
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb must be plural ('were').
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब अपने सबसे पास वाले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

---

[Q912] The principal asked the monitor to distribute the sweets between all the students.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) among all the students
(b) amongst every students
(c) between every student
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Between' is used for two objects/persons, while 'among' is used for more than two. Since there are 'all the students' (more than two), 'among' is correct.
उदा. दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'between' केवल दो के लिए आता है।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Between vs Among)

---

[Q913] If I was you, I would never accept such a humiliating offer.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I were you
(b) If I am you
(c) If I had been you
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation or unreal present, 'were' is used with all subjects, including singular pronouns like 'I'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Imaginative sentences) में सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'I' के बाद भी 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood (Conditional Sentences)

[Q914] One of the most efficient worker in our office has been promoted.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) most efficient workers
(b) more efficient workers
(c) most efficient worker
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Therefore, 'worker' must be changed to 'workers'.
उदा. 'One of the' के बाद हमेशा Noun बहुवचन (Plural noun) फॉर्म में होता है, लेकिन Verb एकवचन (Singular) होती है। इसलिए 'worker' की जगह 'workers' होगा।
[RULE] Nouns after 'One of the'

---

[Q915] He insisted to accompany me to the railway station despite my refusal.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) insisted on accompanying
(b) insisted for accompanying
(c) insisted to accompanying
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'Insist' वर्ब के बाद हमेशा प्रीपोजिशन 'on' और उसके बाद Gerund (V1+ing) यानी 'accompanying' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Fixed Prepositions with Gerunds

---

[Q916] She speaks English with a fluent accent, which impresses every one.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) fluently
(b) in fluent accent
(c) fluent in accent
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
An adverb is required to modify how someone speaks. 'Fluently' is the correct adverb replacing the adjective 'fluent' modifying the verb 'speaks'.
उदा. वर्ब ('speaks') की विशेषता बताने के लिए Adjective ('fluent') की जगह Adverb ('fluently') का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Adjective vs Adverb Usage

[Q917] The manager as well as his subordinates were blamed for the financial loss.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) was blamed
(b) are blamed
(c) have blamed
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Hence, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। 'The manager' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'As well as'

[Q918] Hardly had I stepped out of the house *when it started raining* heavily.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) than it started raining
(b) when it started raining
(c) then it started raining
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. Therefore, the original sentence is grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)। इसलिए दिया गया वाक्य सही है।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairing (Hardly... when)

---

[Q919] She is *more taller than* her sister by two inches.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) taller than
(b) more taller then
(c) most tallest than
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives ('more taller') are grammatically incorrect in English. Use the single comparative form 'taller'.
उदा. एक ही वाक्य में दो comparative words ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग गलत है। सही रूप 'taller than' होगा।
[RULE] Superfluous Comparatives

[Q920] If I was you, *I would not trust* him with my money.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) I will not trust
(b) I were you, I would not trust
(c) If I were you, I would not trust
(d) No improvement
[ANS] c
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary or unreal situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, including singular pronouns like 'I'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में कर्ता चाहे कोई भी हो, 'was' के स्थान पर हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences (Subjunctive Mood)

[Q921] The manager asked the employee *why was he late* for the important meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) why he was late
(b) why was he being late
(c) why is he late
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In indirect speech or embedded questions, the sentence structure changes from interrogative (verb + subject) to assertive (subject + verb).
उदा. Indirect speech या embedded question में प्रश्नसूचक शब्द के बाद पहले Subject आता है और फिर Verb (why he was late), न कि 'why was he late'।
[RULE] Direct to Indirect / Embedded Question Structure

[Q922] Each of the students *were given* a prize for their outstanding performance.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) were given
(b) was given
(c) are given
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The pronouns 'Each', 'Everyone', 'Either', etc., take a singular verb because they refer to individuals separately.
उदा. 'Each' के साथ हमेशा Singular Verb ('was') का प्रयोग होता है, भले ही इसके बाद आने वाला noun plural हो।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Each'

[Q923] No sooner did the police arrive *when the thieves fled* from the scene.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) than the thieves fled
(b) then the thieves fled
(c) when the thieves fled
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is always 'than', not 'when' or 'then'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairing (No sooner... than)

[Q924] She has *a great passion for* music and painting.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) great passion of
(b) great passion in
(c) great passion with
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The noun 'passion' is correctly followed by the preposition 'for' when expressing enthusiasm for something.
उदा. 'Passion' शब्द के साथ उचित प्रीपोज़िशन 'for' का प्रयोग होता है। वाक्य में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
[RULE] Fixed Prepositions

[Q925] He told me that he *has completed* his graduation two years ago.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) had completed
(b) completed
(c) has been completing
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When the reporting verb is in the past tense ('told') and the reported speech contains a past time marker ('two years ago'), the tense changes to Past Perfect ('had completed').
उदा. वाक्य में 'two years ago' भूतकाल के समय को दर्शाता है और मुख्य क्लॉज past tense में है, इसलिए Present Perfect ('has completed') की जगह Past Perfect ('had completed') आएगा।
[RULE] Sequence of Tenses

[Q926] Despite of working hard, *he failed to secure* good marks in the examination.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Despite working hard
(b) In spite working hard
(c) Although working hard
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (Note: 'In spite' takes 'of'). Therefore, 'Despite working hard' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः सही विकल्प 'Despite working hard' है।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

(a) were present
(b) is present
(c) are present
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब अपने सबसे नज़दीकी सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' (Plural) के अनुसार 'were' आएगा।

[Q948] The new policy, which has been announced by the government, aims to reduce pollution.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) that was announced by the government
(b) which is announced by the government
(c) that has been announced by the government
(d) which was announced by the government
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The relative clause refers to a past event, so the simple past ‘was announced’ is preferable to the present perfect. 
उदाहरण: The new policy, which was announced by the government, aims to reduce pollution.
[RULE] Relative clause – simple past for past events

---

[Q949] The committee, which is expected to meet next month, has already decided on the budget.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) that is meeting next month
(b) which will meet next month
(c) that is expected to meet next month
(d) which has decided on the budget
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The clause should correctly express the future expectation; ‘is expected to meet’ is the best choice. 
उदाहरण: The committee, that is expected to meet next month, has already decided on the budget.
[RULE] Future expectation – ‘is expected to’

---

[Q950] The book, which was written by a famous author, has sold over a million copies.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which was written by a famous writer
(b) that was written by a famous author
(c) which has written by a famous author
(d) that was written by a famous writer
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The relative pronoun should be ‘that’ when it refers to a single object and the clause is a simple past. 
उदाहरण: The book, that was written by a famous author, has sold over a million copies.
[RULE] Relative pronoun – ‘that’ for antecedent reference

---

[Q951] The city, which is known for its festivals, attracts tourists from all over the world.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which is famous for its festivals
(b) that is known for its festivals
(c) which is known for its festivals
(d) that is famous for its festivals
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Both ‘which’ and ‘that’ can be used, but the clause is correctly expressed with the simple present ‘is known’. 
उदाहरण: The city, which is known for its festivals, attracts tourists from all over the world.
[RULE] Relative clause – simple present for general truth

---

[Q952] The team, which had been practicing for months, finally won the championship.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) that had practiced for months
(b) which has been practicing for months
(c) that had been practicing for months
(d) which has practiced for months
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The past perfect ‘had been practicing’ correctly indicates the action completed before the win. 
उदाहरण: The team, that had been practicing for months, finally won the championship.
[RULE] Past perfect for completed action before another past event

---

[Q953] The report, which will be released on Monday, contains detailed statistics.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which is released on Monday
(b) that will release on Monday
(c) which will be released on Monday
(d) that is released on Monday
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The clause correctly uses the future passive ‘will be released’. 
उदाहरण: The report, which will be released on Monday, contains detailed statistics.
[RULE] Future passive construction

---

[Q954] The scientist, who had suggested a new theory, was recognized by the academy.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) who suggested a new theory
(b) who had suggested a new theory
(c) who has suggested a new theory
(d) Whimsical
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Past perfect ‘had suggested’ correctly marks the action before recognition. 
उदाहरण: The scientist, who had suggested a new theory, was recognized by the academy.
[RULE] Past perfect for antecedent action

---

[Q955] The artwork, which was created during the Renaissance, is admired world wide.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which has been created during the Renaissance
(b) which was created during the Renaissance
(c) which is created during the Renaissance
(d) which was creating during the Renaissance
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The simple past ‘was created’ correctly indicates the time of creation. 
उदाहरण: The artwork, which was created during the Renaissance, is admired worldwide.
[RULE] Simple past for historical events

---

[Q956] The company, which has recently expanded its operations, plans to open new offices.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) which recently expanded its operations
(b) which is recently expanding its operations
(c) which has recently expanded its operations
(d) which recently expands its operations
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The present perfect ‘has recently expanded’ correctly conveys a recent completion. 
उदाहरण: The company, which has recently expanded its operations, plans to open new offices.
[RULE] Present perfect for recent actions

---

[Q957] The athlete, who had trained for years, broke the world record.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) who is training for years
(b) who trained for years
(c) who had trained for years
(d) who has trained for years
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Past perfect ‘had trained’ indicates training completed before the record. 
उदाहरण: The athlete, who had trained for years, broke the world record.
[RULE] Past perfect for preceding action

---

[Q958] He stopped the meeting ___, because a senior officer had arrived.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) abruptly
(b) with a suddenness
(c) abruptlyly
(d) abrupt
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Use an adverb to modify the verb. The correct adverb is "abruptly".
उदाहरण: "उसे अचानक बैठक रोकनी पड़ी क्योंकि…"
[RULE] Adverb / Adverbial

---

[Q959] The committee will consider the proposal ___.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) careful manner
(b) in a careful manner
(c) carefully in a manner
(d) Affluent
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule: The adverb "carefully" should directly modify the verb phrase. The correct wording is "carefully in a manner".
उदाहरण: "समिति प्रस्ताव पर सावधानीपूर्वक विचार करेगी…"
[RULE] Adverb placement

---

[Q960] He managed ___ his responsibilities effectively.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) to balance
(b) balancing
(c) balancingly
(d) balance
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: After the verb "manage", a gerund is used to indicate the action performed. Thus "balancing" is correct.
उदाहरण: "उसने अपनी जिम्मेदारियों को संतुलित करने का प्रबंध किया…"
[RULE] Gerund usage

---

[Q961] The book, ___ by the author, has been widely praised.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) written by
(b) writing by
(c) written by the
(d) writing the author
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Use the past participle to form a passive clause. "Written by" is correct.
उदाहरण: "किताब को लेखक ने लिखा है और इसे व्यापक प्रशंसा मिली है…"
[RULE] Past participle / Passive voice

---

[Q962] She could not attend the conference, ___ she was ill.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) because
(b) because of
(c) due to
(d) due to of
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Use the conjunction "because" to express reason. "Because of" is a preposition phrase and does not fit here.
उदाहरण: "वह सम्मेलन में नहीं जा सकी क्योंकि वह बीमार थी…"
[RULE] Conjunction / Subordinating conjunction

---

[Q963] The new policy ___ to reduce costs.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) aims at
(b) aims to
(c) aims for
(d) aims for to
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: After the verb "aims", the infinitive form "to reduce" follows. "Aims at" is incorrect in this context.
उदाहरण: "नई नीति लागत घटाने का लक्ष्य रखती है…"
[RULE] Infinitive / Verb complement

---

[Q964] The students, ___ to the exam, studied diligently.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) prepared for
(b) prepared to
(c) prepared with
(d) prepared for the
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Use the preposition "for" after "prepared" when referring to an event. Hence "prepared for" is correct.
उदाहरण: "छात्रों ने परीक्षा के लिए तैयारी की और कड़ी मेहनत की…"
[RULE] Preposition usage

---

[Q965] He was praised ___ his efforts.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) for for
(b) for
(c) to for
(d) by for
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: The preposition "for" follows the verb "praised" to indicate the cause of praise. "For for" is redundant.
उदाहरण: "उसे उसके प्रयासों के लिए प्रशंसा मिली…"
[RULE] Preposition after verb

---

[Q966] The painting, ___ by the artist, was displayed.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) exhibited by
(b) exhibited by the
(c) exhibit by
(d) exhibited the artist
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: Use the past participle "exhibited" with "by" to form a passive clause. "Exhibited by the" is over‑specified.
उदाहरण: "कलाकार द्वारा प्रदर्शित पेंटिंग को दर्शकों ने सराहा…"
[RULE] Past participle / Passive voice

---

[Q967] She will finish the report ___.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) on time
(b) in time
(c) at time
(d) on a time
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: The idiomatic phrase "on time" means punctual. "In time" has a different meaning and "at time" is incorrect.
उदाहरण: "वह रिपोर्ट समय पर पूरा करेगी…"
[RULE] Idiomatic phrase

---

[Q968] He is too intelligent so he can solve this complex puzzle easily.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) too intelligent so
(b) so intelligent that
(c) very intelligent that
(d) too intelligent that
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Use 'so... that' to show cause and effect instead of 'too... so'.
उदा. 'too... to' का प्रयोग होता है या 'so... that' का, यहाँ 'so intelligent that' सही है।
[RULE] Conjunction (so... that)

---

[Q969] Hardly had I reached the station than the train left.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) when the train left
(b) than the train left
(c) then the train left
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (than का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

---

[Q970] Neither of the two boys have submitted their assignments.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) have submitted their
(b) has submitted their
(c) has submitted his
(d) have submitted his
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Neither of' takes a singular verb and singular masculine possessive pronoun ('his').
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद verb एक वचन (has) तथा pronoun भी एक वचन (his) आता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement & Pronoun

---

[Q971] She speaks English fluently, isn't it?
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) doesn't she
(b) isn't she
(c) does she
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
For the present simple tense ('speaks'), the correct question tag is 'doesn't she'.
उदा. Present simple tense की सकारात्मक क्रिया 'speaks' के लिए question tag 'doesn't she' होगा।
[RULE] Question Tags

---

[Q972] The climate of Shimla is better than Delhi.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) better than Delhi
(b) superior than Delhi
(c) better than that of Delhi
(d) better than those of Delhi
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Comparison must be between same things. We compare the climate of Shimla to the climate of Delhi ('that of').
उदा. शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना दिल्ली की जलवायु से हो रही है, इसलिए 'that of Delhi' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Degree of Comparison

---

[Q973] Each of the players were given a medal for their performance.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were given a medal for their
(b) was given a medal for his
(c) were given medals for their
(d) was given a medal for their
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' is followed by a singular verb and singular pronoun.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद singular verb (was) और singular possessive pronoun (his) का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

---

[Q974] Despite of working hard, he failed the examination.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite of working
(b) In spite working
(c) Despite working
(d) Although worked
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. 'In spite' takes 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ होता है)।
[RULE] Prepositions (Despite vs In spite of)

---

[Q975] If I was you, I would accept the job offer.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I was you
(b) If I were you
(c) If I am you
(d) If I will be you
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Imaginary or hypothetical sentences use 'were' for all subjects in the 'if' clause.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्य (Subjunctive mood) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences (Subjunctive Mood)

[Q976] No sooner did the sun rise when the fog disappeared.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) did the sun rise when
(b) had the sun risen than
(c) did the sun rise than
(d) does the sun rise than
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'No sooner' is followed by 'did + V1' and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद V1 और आगे संयोजन 'than' आता है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (No sooner... than)

---

[Q977] She told to me that she would help me with my project.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) told me
(b) said me
(c) told to me
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Tell' does not take a preposition 'to' when followed by an object.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधा object आता है, बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (जबकि 'said to' होता है)।
[RULE] Verbs followed by Objects (Tell vs Say)

---

[Q978] Hardly had I arrived at the station than the train left.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Hardly had I arrived at the station when
(b) Hardly I had arrived at the station than
(c) Hardly had I arrived at the station then
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when', not 'than'. Also, inversion (auxiliary verb before subject) is required after 'Hardly' at the beginning.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

---

[Q979] Neither of the two candidates have submitted their documents.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) Neither of the two candidates has submitted their documents
(b) Neither of the two candidates have submitted his documents
(c) Neither of the two candidates has submitted his documents
(d) No improvement
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Neither of' takes a singular verb and a masculine singular pronoun ('his' or 'he') in formal English when gender is not specified.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद verb हमेशा singular (has) आती है और pronoun भी singular (his) ही प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement & Pronoun Agreement

---

[Q980] She is more taller than her sister.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) more taller than
(b) taller than
(c) most taller than
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Double comparatives are grammatically incorrect. 'Tall' takes '-er' to form its comparative degree ('taller'), so 'more' is redundant.
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative words ('more' और 'taller') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। सही रूप 'taller than' है।
[RULE] Superfluous Expressions / Degrees of Comparison

---

[Q981] He told to me that he would help me with the project.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) told me that
(b) said me that
(c) asked to me that
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Tell' is a transitive verb when followed by an object, so it does not take the preposition 'to' directly after it. 'He told me' is correct.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधे object आता है, बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'said' के बाद 'to' आ सकता है)।
[RULE] Transitive Verbs and Prepositions

---

[Q982] The committee were divided in its opinions regarding the new policy.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) was divided in their opinions
(b) were divided in their opinions
(c) was divided in its opinions
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When a collective noun like 'committee' is divided in opinion, it takes a plural verb and plural pronouns ('their').
उदा. जब collective noun (जैसे committee) में मतभेद हो, तो वह plural verb (were) और plural pronoun (their) लेता है।
[RULE] Collective Nouns and Pronoun Agreement

---

[Q983] I look forward to meet you soon.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) look forward to meeting
(b) am looking forward to meet
(c) look forward for meeting
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrasal verb 'look forward to' is followed by a gerund (verb + ing), not a bare infinitive.
उदा. 'Look forward to' के बाद हमेशा gerund (v1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है, न कि base verb का।
[RULE] Gerunds after Specific Prepositions/Phrases

---

[Q984] No sooner did the bell ring when the students rushed out of the class room.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) ring than the students
(b) rung than the students
(c) ring then the students
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'No sooner' must be followed by 'than', not 'when' or 'then'. Also, 'did' takes the base form of the verb ('ring').
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (No sooner... than)

---

[Q985] If I was a bird, I would fly across the oceans.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I were a bird
(b) If I am a bird
(c) If I have been a bird
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Imaginary or hypothetical conditional sentences use 'were' for all subjects in the 'if' clause, regardless of number.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक इच्छा (Subjunctive Mood) को व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood / Conditional Sentences

---

[Q986] One of my friends are going to London next week.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) friends is going
(b) friend is going
(c) friend are going
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb because the subject is 'One'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद noun/pronoun तो plural होता है (friends), लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (is) आती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'One' होता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun)

---

[Q987] Despite of his hard work, he failed the examination.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) In spite
(b) Despite
(c) Although of
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Despite' is synonymous with 'In spite of', but 'Despite' does not take the preposition 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। 'In spite of' और 'Despite' दोनों का अर्थ 'के बावजूद' होता है।
[RULE] Prepositions (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q988] The underlined phrase is best replaced by: [have been doing] (in the sentence: "The students have been doing their assignments for the last week.")
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) "are doing"
(b) "have done"
(c) "have been doing"
(d) "did"
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use the present perfect continuous tense to indicate an action that started in the past and continues to the present.
उदाहरण: "The students have been doing their assignments for the last week."
[RULE] Present Perfect Continuous

[Q989] The underlined phrase is best replaced by: [was following] (in the sentence: "The dog was following the boy, and the boy was carrying a bag.")
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) "is following"
(b) "was followed"
(c) "had followed"
(d) "was following"
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use simple past tense for both verbs in a sentence describing simultaneous actions in the past.
उदाहरण: "The dog was following the boy, and the boy was carrying a bag."
[RULE] Past Tense Consistency

---

[Q990] The underlined phrase is best replaced by: [has been] (in the sentence: "The committee has been reviewing the proposal for two months.")
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) "had been"
(b) "is"
(c) "has been"
(d) "will be"
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use the present perfect continuous tense to indicate an action that started in the past and continues to the present.
उदाहरण: "The committee has been reviewing the proposal for two months."
[RULE] Present Perfect Continuous

---

[Q991] The underlined phrase is best replaced by: [was] (in the sentence: "The teacher was explaining the concept, while the students were listening attentively.")
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) "is"
(b) "was"
(c) "will be"
(d) "had been"
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use past continuous tense for actions happening simultaneously in the past.

[Q999] Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class room.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were present in the classroom
(b) are present in the classroom
(c) have present in the classroom
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'students' (plural), so the plural verb 'were' is required.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1000] She insisted to go to the party despite her mother's warning.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) insisted on going
(b) insisted to going
(c) insisted for going
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'Insist' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।

[Q1001] If I was you, I would not accept this offer under any circumstances.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I were you
(b) If I am you
(c) If I have been you
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation or wish, 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood / Conditionals

[Q1002] One of the most important problem facing the country is unemployment.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) most important problems facing
(b) more important problem facing
(c) most important problem faces
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'problem' must be changed to 'problems'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा Plural Noun का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'problem' की जगह 'problems' होगा।
[RULE] Noun Number Rule (One of + Plural Noun)

[Q1003] No sooner did the police arrive than the thieves ran away.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) No sooner had the police arrive than
(b) No sooner did the police arrived than
(c) No sooner the police arrived than
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is followed by inversion (did + V1) and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह सही है। 'No sooner' के बाद helping verb (did) + V1 और फिर 'than' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है।
[RULE] Inversion and Conjunctions

[Q1004] Despite of working hard, he failed to clear the examination.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite working hard
(b) In spite working hard
(c) Despite of worked hard
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Thus, 'Despite working' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (In spite के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः 'Despite working' सही है।
[RULE] Prepositional Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q1005] Each of the participants were given a certificate of appreciation.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) was given a certificate
(b) were given certificates
(c) are given a certificate
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb. 'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('was').
उदा. 'Each' एक singular pronoun है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb ('was') का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Each/Every)

[Q1006] The manager told his subordinates that they must complete the project by tomorrow.

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) by the next day
(b) by tomorrow onwards
(c) till tomorrow
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In indirect speech, words indicating nearness of time are changed. 'Tomorrow' changes to 'the next day' or 'the following day'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में 'tomorrow' बदलकर 'the next day' हो जाता है।
[RULE] Direct and Indirect Speech (Time Adverbs)

[Q1007] Scarcely had I reached the station when the train left.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) Scarcely had I reached the station than the train left
(b) Scarcely I had reached the station when the train left
(c) Scarcely did I reached the station when the train left
(d) No improvement
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'Scarcely' takes 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'when'.
उदा. वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है। 'Scarcely' के साथ 'had + V3' और 'when' का सही संयोजन है।

[Q1008] Hardly had I stepped out of the house *when it began to rain* heavily.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) than it began to rain
(b) when it began to rain
(c) then it began to rain
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. Therefore, 'when it began to rain' is grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcarly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q1009] If I *was you*, I would not tolerate this insult.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) am you
(b) were you
(c) have been you
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, regardless of person or number.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक शर्त (Hypothetical sentence) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood / Conditional Sentences

[Q1010] The teacher asked the students *that why they were* making a noise.

(a) why were they
(b) why they were
(c) that why were they
(d) No improvement
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In indirect speech of a Wh- question, the question word acts as a conjunction, and the subject precedes the verb (assertive sentence structure). 'That' is not used before the question word.
उदा. Indirect speech में Wh- question पूछने पर 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं होता और Wh- word के बाद Subject फिर Verb आता है।
[RULE] Indirect Speech & Clause Structure

[Q1011] He is one of those persons who *is always helping* the poor.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) are always helping
(b) is always help
(c) are always help
(d) No improvement
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb agrees with the antecedent, which is plural ('persons'). Thus, 'are' is correct.
उदा. 'One of those + plural noun + who' की बनावट में relative pronoun (who) का antecedent बहुवचन noun होता है, इसलिए verb भी plural (are) आएगी।

[Q1012] Neither the manager nor his subordinates *was present* at the meeting.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) were present

(c) are present

[ANS] a
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('subordinates', which is plural). Hence, 'were present' is correct.
उदा. जब दो Subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject (subordinates) के अनुसार आती है, जो कि बहुवचन है।

[Q1013] She is *more taller than* her sister.

(d) No improvement

Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative adjective, so 'more' is redundant.
उदा. एक ही विशेषण के साथ दो comparative words ('more' और 'taller') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

[SOL]
The correct correlative pair for 'No sooner' is 'than'. The sentence is already grammatically correct.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ सही जोड़ी (correlative) 'than' होती है। वाक्य में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

[Q1015] He told me that he *has finished* his work before I arrived.

(b) finished
(c) was finished

When two past actions happen at different times, the earlier action takes the past perfect tense (had + V3) and the later action takes the simple past.
उदा. भूतकाल में घटित दो घटनाओं में से जो कार्य पहले समाप्त हुआ हो, उसके लिए Past Perfect Tense (had + V3) का प्रयोग होता है।

(a) were given

(d) No improvement

'Each of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun, but the verb and possessive pronoun following it must be singular.

'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Therefore, 'Despite working hard' is correct.

[Q1018] The manager as well as the clerks [were present] at the meeting yesterday.

(a) was present
